6_coverage_floor_candidate_provenance.source_function: scripts/run_melody_comparison.py:_coverage_floor_candidate (around line 2495), called from evaluate_comparison around lines 3132/3155
6_coverage_floor_candidate_provenance.selection_rule: iterates ALL tuning-split pairs with expected=='same' (positive_transform), regardless of comparison.evidence, and appends comparison.coverage['aligned_note_fraction_a'] and ['aligned_note_fraction_b'] whenever the field is not None -- this is NOT gated on evidence != 'not_comparable', so a pair whose gate marks it not_comparable can still contribute a coverage value (observed here as 0.0 from pt_real_tuning_vocadito_17_pitch_p3).
